review.eventDescription: One delivered review snapshot ($1 per 1,000 rows; row keys id, app_id, review_text, language, recommended, created_at, updated_at, helpful_votes, funny_votes, content_hash, fetched_at). No start fee; proxy and compute included. Filters, duplicates, excluded rows and failures without delivered rows are free. Stops at maxTotalChargeUsd (Apify run option, not input). Nested data included; partial errors retain paid rows already delivered. Inspect free SUMMARY for page limits and source errors.
